instruction: A hovering hummingbird rendered as a single seamless pour of mirror-liquid metal, its blurred wings frozen as two smooth teardrop sheets caught mid-beat. The long needle bill stretches forward as a tapering chrome spike and the tail splays into flowing molten ribbons. Every surface warps reflections with no seams, joints or texture.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Liquid Chrome Hummingbird in a liquid-chrome style. The long needle bill stretches forward as a tapering chrome spike and the tail splays into flowing molten ribbons. Every surface warps reflections with no seams, joints or texture. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
